learning_outcomes.text: Know how to lead an unplugged computer science workshop
Explain the link between the workshop and computer science
Interact professionally with the teacher in charge of a class
Know how to promote equal participation of boys and girls in a scientific activity

syllabus_topics: Appropriate an unplugged computer science activity
Prepare to lead a workshop in conjunction with the teacher of a cycle 3 class (CM1/CM2/6th grade)
Experiment their workshop with the students of that class
Analyze the activity's progress a posteriori
